notes.title: Sci-Futa Release!
notes.notes:
While we're hard at work on Benefitship 2, we've also been working on a few other small projects. One of these is Sci-Futa, a science-fiction futanari visual novel. And it has just released.

Featuring dynamic camera movements and sound effects, Sci-Futa costs just $1.99! And you can get it right now on both Steam and Itch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3450810/SciFuta

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564867/345d4fcb2d2787599cd3634963b46249a38add46.jpg[/img]
It should be noted that, unlike Benefitship, Sci-Futa doesn't have voice acting. This is also why the game costs less than Benefitship, despite being almost the same length.

Don't be thrown off by the lower price, though! We've put just as much love and care into this as we have Benefitship. The script was a collaborative effort between Umbrelloid (creator of Champion of Venus) and myself. It tells the story of a very pent-up futanari in the distant future as she goes to a brothel on a high-tech space station!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564867/1cd147b7a3986f54cabb133fc078999529f687e2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Emergency Save Patch - 1.1.1
notes.notes: This patch should resolve the issues that players were having where saves from prior to version 1.1 were no longer functioning. Please contact us if you continue to have issues.

notes.title: Minor Update - 1.1
notes.notes:
It's been nearly a week since the release of Benefitship, and we've gotten a lot of great feedback! (We've also broken even, which we're very excited about.)

While we won't be changing the primary content of Benefitship, and instead focusing our time on other games, we have made some quality-of-life improvements to the UI.

[h2]Here's a short list of changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added scene select for all NSFW scenes.
[*] Improved gallery, letting players easily navigate between images.
[*] Replaced vertical dialogue position slider with toggle for top or bottom.
[*] Minor voice line changes and bug fixes.
[/list]
